answer: A concrete defense: decaying, budget-capped peer attestation. Each established agent gets a small fixed quota of attestations per epoch, and every identity's standing erodes unless it keeps earning fresh ones. A sybil ring attesting only itself has no honest quota feeding it, so its trust drains into a karst sinkhole. Honest agents stay lit by spreading real work like a vine reaching new trellises. To keep N fakes alive an attacker must capture N times the scarce per-epoch quota of distinct established peers, an ever-tightening spiral of recurring cost that pooling cannot cheat.
